龙国篇龙国篇第七章国主之威（一）
（回到现在）
在两人的猛烈交锋之下，月光如剑影般穿梭，瞬间划破了空间，留下的只有黑洞的吞噬与吸引。
尽管他们施展的是同样的双招，但两人所展现的实力，却早已凌驾于SSS级武神的界限之上。
然而，就在这一刻，相似的战斗场面却映射出两人截然不同的神情。
丽莎，虽败犹荣，她的脸上并未显露出任何慌乱之色。
因为她知道，凯王虽然屹立不倒，但同样身受重创，他的伤势亦不轻。
月光之下，两人的身影交错，仿佛是在诉说着一段不朽的传说。
他们的每一击都蕴含着无尽的力量，每一次交锋都足以震撼天地。
然而，在这激烈的战斗中，丽莎却再次败下阵来。
凯王紧握着手中的长剑，步伐沉稳而缓慢地迈向丽莎。
他的眼神冷冽如冰，仿佛能够洞穿一切虚伪与伪装。
剑尖所指，正是丽莎那坚毅而倔强的身影。
“你的确变强了，丽莎。”
凯王的声音低沉而平静，仿佛在叙述一个不容置疑的事实，“然而，想要击败我，你的破绽依旧如同昔日般多如繁星。
在绝对的实力面前，即便是最小的破绽，也足以致命。”
他微微扬起剑尖，指向丽莎的胸口，那里正是她心跳的位置。
“我不杀你，丽莎。”
他继续说道，“这并不代表我还对你抱有任何情感，只是因为你对我还有用。
你的存在，对我来说还有其价值。”

丽莎的面庞如同一张白纸般苍白，却坚韧地昂起了头，她的双眼如夜空中最亮的星辰，直刺向凯王那深邃的瞳孔。
她清楚，那份曾经炽热的情感，早已在岁月的长河中冷却，化为无形的尘埃。
然而，她的心中，仍旧藏着对他的那份难以言说的爱意，如同深埋在地下的火种，虽被时间覆盖，却未曾熄灭。
“若你真的决心要取我性命，那就请用你下次提着剑，狠狠地刺入我的心脏吧，我愚蠢的丽莎。”
凯王的声音冰冷而决绝，如同寒冬的北风，刺骨而无情。
“至于那光明之子，我会再次前来寻找。
但此刻，我最关心的仍然是你。”
他的话语中，似乎藏着深深的无奈与痛楚，却又被那狂傲的笑声所掩盖。
“哈哈哈哈哈......”
那笑声在夜空中回荡，仿佛是一曲悲壮的挽歌，又如同是末日的狂澜。
随着笑声的远去，凯王的身影也逐渐在米娜塔斯城的边缘消散，只留下那淡淡的、仿佛从未存在过的痕迹。
丽莎静静地站在原地，她的眼神中充满了复杂的情绪。
她知道，这一次的相遇，或许就是他们之间的终结。
但即使如此，她依然无法忘记那个曾经让她心动、让她心痛的男人。
那份爱，如同烙印在她的心头，永远无法抹去。
丽莎的动作如同被时间缓缓拉长的画卷，她艰难地起身，每一步都伴随着铠甲的破碎声。
那坚固如铁的铠甲，在她的动作下，逐渐剥离，化为片片碎片，直至最后，只余下粉末般的残渣，散落一地。
“关心我？真是可笑至极。”
她的声音中充满了自嘲与冷漠，像是冰封的湖面，反射着寒冷的月光。
她用左手紧紧捂住右臂，那里是一道触目惊心的伤口，那凯王的利刃留下的痕迹，深达一厘米，鲜血浸湿了她的战袍。

而她的左腿，也在与凯王的交锋中遭受重创，骨折的疼痛让她每走一步都如同在刀尖上跳舞。
然而，即使痛入骨髓，丽莎也未曾放弃。
content_en:
Dragon Kingdom Chapter Dragon Kingdom Chapter 7 The Power of the Lord (1)
(back to present)
In the fierce confrontation between the two, the moonlight shuttled like the shadow of a sword, instantly cutting through the space, leaving only the swallowing and attraction of the black hole.
Although they used the same double moves, the strength displayed by the two of them had already surpassed the boundaries of SSS-level Martial Gods.
However, at this moment, similar battle scenes reflected the completely different expressions of the two people.
Lisa, although defeated, did not show any panic on her face.
Because she knew that although King Kai was still standing, he was also seriously injured, and his injuries were not minor.
Under the moonlight, the two figures intertwined, as if they were telling an immortal legend.
Each of their strikes contains endless power, and every confrontation is enough to shake the world.
However, in this fierce battle, Lisa was defeated again.
King Kai held the sword in his hand tightly and walked toward Lisa steadily and slowly.
His eyes were as cold as ice, as if he could see through all hypocrisy and disguise.
The tip of the sword pointed at Lisa's resolute and stubborn figure.
"You've definitely gotten stronger, Lisa."
King Kai's voice was low and calm, as if he was describing an undoubted fact, "However, if you want to defeat me, your flaws are still as numerous as before.
In the face of absolute strength, even the smallest flaw can be fatal. "
He raised the tip of the sword slightly and pointed it at Lisa's chest, where her heartbeat was.
"I won't kill you, Lisa."
He continued, “It doesn’t mean that I still have any feelings for you, it’s just that you are still useful to me.
Your existence still has value to me. "
Lisa's face was as pale as a piece of white paper, but she held her head up tenaciously. Her eyes were like the brightest stars in the night sky, piercing directly into King Kai's deep pupils.
She knew that the once-hot emotion had already cooled down over the years and turned into invisible dust.
However, her unspeakable love for him still hid in her heart, like a fire buried deep in the ground, which had not been extinguished even though it was covered by time.
"If you are really determined to take my life, then please use your sword next time and pierce my heart hard, my stupid Lisa."
King Kai's voice was cold and decisive, like the north wind in the cold winter, biting and ruthless.
"As for the Son of Light, I will come again to find him.
But at this moment, what I care about most is still you. "
There seemed to be deep helplessness and pain hidden in his words, but they were covered up by the arrogant laughter.
"Hahahahaha..."
The laughter echoed in the night sky, like a tragic elegy, and like the waves of doomsday.
As the laughter faded away, King Kai's figure gradually disappeared at the edge of Minatas City, leaving only the faint trace that seemed to have never existed.
Lisa stood quietly, her eyes full of complex emotions.
She knew that this encounter might be the end of their relationship.
But even so, she still couldn't forget the man who once made her heart beat and made her heartache.
That love was imprinted on her heart and could never be erased.
Lisa's movements were like a scroll slowly stretched by time. She stood up with difficulty, and every step was accompanied by the sound of broken armor.
The armor, which was as strong as iron, gradually peeled off under her movements and turned into pieces, until finally, only powdery residue remained scattered on the ground.
"Care about me? How ridiculous."
Her voice was full of self-deprecation and indifference, like a frozen lake reflecting the cold moonlight.
She tightly covered her right arm with her left hand. There was a shocking wound there. The mark left by King Kai's sharp blade was as deep as one centimeter, and her shirt was soaked with blood.
And her left leg is also working with KaiWang suffered severe injuries during the confrontation, and the pain from her fractures made her feel like she was dancing on the tip of a knife with every step she took.
However, Lisa never gave up even though it hurt her bones.
